durableStorage.description: Must be honest: false when holds are lost on restart. Consumers only enable booking when true.

requiredCustomerFields.description: A consumer must collect these before sending a hold. Default when absent: name, phone.

maxQuantity.description: Largest quantity accepted by one hold. Default 1 when absent.

paymentMode.description: simulated = confirm accepts a `payment` object and records the hold as paid (no money moves). none = confirm rejects `payment` with 400 PAYMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED. Default when absent: none.

items.description: CRS conceptId, e.g. diy:kabupaten-sleman. vehicle_rental offers carry the pickup region that was requested, or null when none was.

serviceRegions.description: vehicle_rental only: regions where pickup or delivery is possible. An offers request for any other region returns an empty list.
